SELECT sys_attachment.id, sys_attachment.`status`, sys_attachment.create_time, storage_name, original_name, extension_name, path, upload_id, business_code, business_name, size, type, upload_mode, storage_location, md5, is_public, error_msg, sys_user.nickname as uploadName, client_type FROM sys_attachment LEFT JOIN sys_user ON sys_user.id = sys_attachment.create_id
WHERE sys_attachment.id = #{id} AND sys_attachment.del_flag = '0'
